user.title: Add room
user.description: Temperatures are on the thermostat's own scale. Schedule: one line per group of days, e.g. `mon-fri 06:30 comfort, 09:30 eco, 17:00 comfort, 22:30 sleep`. Days: mon…sun, ranges (mon-fri), lists (sat,sun) or daily (Korean 월…일 and 매일 work too). Presets: comfort, sleep, eco, away (편안, 수면, 절약, 외출). A block lasts until the next entry; a day without a line keeps the previous block.

data_description.name: Defaults to the thermostat's name.
data_description.eco: The house is occupied but this room isn't in use.
data_description.away: The house is certainly empty. Never below 18 °C.
data_description.follows_daycare: Comfort blocks become eco while the daycare sensor is on (a child's room).
data_description.occupancy_entity: Someone in the room for 10 minutes turns an eco block into comfort, kept for an hour after they leave; a comfort block nobody uses for two hours drops to eco.
